steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Gods? Immortals? Come on. You really think there's any of that out there?

steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>You ever see a god pick up a shovel? Put food on your plate?

steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Hey, don't say that. Better to believe in something than nothing at all...

steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>You know what they say. Human will can conquer heaven itself. I still remember the year that the rogue god went on a rampage. Not a single blade of grass left standing. Lives lost beyond counting. But heroes rose up, stood their ground, and struck that wicked god down atop the clouds.

steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>The heroes may be long gone now, but if you're as brave as they were—not afraid of the dark, not afraid of thunder, not afraid of the things that bare their claws in your dreams—then they'll watch over you too. Right there in those same dreams. ...Hey, what'd you kick me for?

steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>...What do you mean I'm feeding the kids lies? It's been thundering every night for a week. I told them a little story, and now they sleep through it without crying. Tell me what's so wrong about that.

steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Oh, enough with all this talk. Let's just focus on getting by...

steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Gods, heroes, whatever you put your faith in, doesn't really matter, does it? At the end of the day, everyone's just looking for a little peace of mind.
This is where a myth ends. And where another begins.
You lie on the ground and let the voices drift softly into your ears. Are they from a century ago, or from a time much closer to your own? You cannot tell.
In this moment, you do nothing but listen.
Hymns of praise, rising year after year.
At last, the quiet, unchanging sky of Maria City appears before your eyes.
Chengxiao pulls you up from the ground and, with a smile, dusts off your shoulders.
The wind threads through the ruins, and time begins to move again. Only the body lying still nearby remains unmoved.
